name: source-sidenote
description: Local-first AI code reading service with persistent per-file explanations and editor adapters
author: zhuliminl

scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && tsc && npm run build -w web
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && npm run check -w web && npm run check -w editors/vscode
scripts.format: prettier --write src web/src editors/vscode/src editors/vscode/media tests docs *.md *.json .github/workflows/*.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src web/src editors/vscode/src editors/vscode/media tests docs *.md *.json .github/workflows/*.yml
